item.title: Josh Gad to Play Actor Kurt Gerron in GERRON'S LAST FILM Biopic
item.description: Josh Gad is set to star in Gerron's Last Film, a forthcoming movie based on the true story of Jewish actor and director Kurt Gerron, Deadline reports. Simon Curtis (Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale) is directing from a screenplay by Ehud Lavski and Alon Gur Arye. Gad will play the famed actor, who served as the original performer of the song Mack the Knife during the 1928 premiere of Bertolt Brecht’s The Threepenny Opera in Berlin. item.title: Award-Winning Actress and Comedian Catherine O'Hara Passes Away at 71
item.description: BroadwayWorld is saddened to report that the award-winning actress and comedian Catherine O'Hara has passed away at the age of 71. Her death was confirmed by her agency, which shared that she passed following a brief illness. Across her storied career, she appeared in many films and projects that have gone on to become beloved favorites by audiences. item.title: The Bowery Electric to Permanently Close This Weekend
item.description: After 17 years, the nightclub Bowery Electric will be closing its doors on On January 31. The venue shared, "We want to thank all the great bands, DJ's, staff, and patrons that have been part of this incredible run." The newly-renovated Bowery Palace will open February 18, 2026 in the same location, at 327 Bowery. item.title: Minnesota Orchestra Dedicates Weekend Concerts to Alex Pretti and Renee Good
item.description: The Minnesota Orchestra has announced a program update for its concerts this weekend, dedicating the performances to the memory of Alex Pretti and Renee Good. item.title: Woodie King, Jr., Founder of New Federal Theatre, Passes Away at 88
item.description: Producer, director, and New Federal Theatre founder Woodie King Jr. passed away at age 88 at Weill Cornell Medical Center on January 29, following complications from emergency heart surgery. Known for his more than five decades spent providing opportunities for minorities and women in the performing arts, King was named a "Legend of Off Broadway" by the Off-Broadway Alliance in 2020 — the same year his New Federal Theatre received the Tony Honors for Excellence in the Theatre.
